nodes.label: Pricing Tier Configuration
nodes.rationale: Five tiers: FREE (0 cost), STANDARD ($29/month), TEAM ($39/month), PRO ($49/month), ULTIMATE ($99/month). Each tier defines limits: channels, posts, image/video generation, team members, webhooks, public API, autoPost capability.

nodes.label: Review Link Token Validation
nodes.rationale: Defense-in-depth validation: token format check (base64url 16-128 chars), expiration check (null or future), revocation check (revokedAt null), constant-time comparison for postId match, rate limiting per IP/kind, HTML stripping and input sanitization.

nodes.label: OAuth Pattern with ClientInformation
nodes.rationale: Each provider must propagate ClientInformation through generateAuthUrl() and authenticate() methods for per-profile OAuth credentials (never hardcode process.env). This enables multi-tenancy where workspace/profile-level credentials override org-level defaults.

nodes.label: Social Provider Error Handling Pattern
nodes.rationale: Providers extend SocialAbstract which defines handleErrors() to classify failures as 'refresh-token' (expired), 'bad-body' (invalid payload), or 'retry'. This allows centralized retry logic in orchestrator activities.

nodes.label: Zernio Multi-Platform Abstraction
nodes.rationale: All Zernio providers (bluesky, facebook, instagram, linkedin, pinterest, reddit, snapchat, telegram, etc.) inherit from ZernioBaseProvider and pass (platform, platformName, charLimit). This reduces code duplication by delegating platform-specific logic to the Zernio API.
